foundry_library.native_overshoot_qualification: Keep all native CMI and six simultaneous physical terminal pairs per actual core MOS; standard-cell use is no exemption.

SR.reset_priority: R=1 statically forces Q=0 with either S value; dynamics not inferred
SR.mapping: one standard INV + three standard ND2 in original feedback wiring; not a DFF/latch substitution
SR.retained_explicit_CQB: review as wrapper-level QB load, never attach to hidden foundry transistor nodes; exact capacitance retention decision required before candidate freeze
SR.future_test_sequence: sr_cycle_v1/contract.json; reset/hold-release-set/hold-reset-from-Qhigh and both overlap-release orders; use real native input drivers/fanout
SR.drive_and_feedback_warning: Cross-coupled standard NANDs still need analog loop/startup, simultaneous R/S, minimum pulse, reset release and stress verification.

DFFR.source_static_structure: master input TG on CK=0; slave input TG on CK=1; RN=!RST forces both latch outputs low when RST=1
DFFR.ideal_switch_contract: positive edge; asynchronous active-high reset Q=0; dynamic setup/hold and recovery/removal not specified by structural inspection
DFFR.blocking_evidence: Need read-only actual DFCNQD1 truth/Liberty or original transistor switching graph + bounded native reset/edge bench, including async priority and recovery/removal; names/pin list alone insufficient. No remote query performed here.
DFFR.reset_fanout: Added RST inverter changes loading, skew, release and pulse widths; dedicated real-fanout validation required.

composite_contracts.validation: RAW/DEC qualification, write-before-update, reset and restart need native pulse/crossing checks; no zero-delay Boolean guarantee.

must_preserve: 8 positive-edge PHI_U DFFs with SAMPLE-high clear
XF7 stores one as NT7 then T7=!NT7; others shift T7 toward T0
composite_contracts.validation: Do not change token polarity/reset seed or insert a new clock.

must_preserve: D captures NEXT_D on PHI_W rising, SAMPLE-high clears
composite_contracts.validation: PHI_W setup/hold, mux path, DOUT settling and token update order.

must_preserve: XSTORE7 captures !TARGET7, MSB_QN clear0, Q7=!MSB_QN gives reset-Q7=1
composite_contracts.validation: Capture early/late request and async reset races, staggered reference reset before sampling, asymmetric MSB polarity and completion must remain.
Both switching directions must measure dead time, no H/L overlap, actual analog driver and bottom-plate load; DEL025 name not an established dead time.
External window and effective close edge are protected; new buffer insertion delays must be measured and cannot be silently retimed.

timing_elements.mapping_policy: No direct replacement by named DEL025D1. Standardize the pure inverter logic only when approved; RC/clamp timing remains an explicitly unresolved block interface until reviewed timing implementation is selected.
required_checks: both edge delays and reset clear
BBM dead time and reference-reset idle schedule
